items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: My drum player, he died, he died, Roy Evans.

ctx.x: Didn't you tell me something about them having different drummers in that band, Lars? Did you change, did this fellow Martin play with the band all the time? Yeah. The drum player. Martin? Didn't you have different drum players in the band? You changed drums? My first band? No, in Lee Collins' band. Did they have the same drum player all the time?

No, no, no. My drum player, he died, he died, Roy Evans. Oh yeah? Yeah. Well, he must be Lee Collins first? He was good boy. He was really good. He was really good. He just died. No, not Lee. He died a little. He died a little. He died a little. He died a little while ago.
Did you ever know a drummer called Rachel? Rachel?
